examples.en: I heard that Liu Suifeng of the Power Gang was there that day. Surviving that great devil's hands—Young Master Feng, you truly are remarkable.
examples.zh: 我听说当日权力帮的柳随风也在。能在那大魔头手下活命，风公子实属不易。

examples.en: Of the three—Li Chenzhou, Zhao Shirong, and Liu Suifeng—very few have ever seen their true faces.
examples.zh: 李沉舟、赵师容、柳随风这三人，知道他们真容的，也并没有几个。
